comment: Attendance is mandatory for students, to the point where we have to provide doctors notes if we miss class, and yet not even halfway into the semester she has already missed 3 classes. Updates her 'syllabus' the day before class so barely any time to do the readings and generally unprepared. Easy class but prepare for choas

Professor Shalash is very good at facilitating class discussions and making everyone feel included. She is also very knowledgeable regarding the subject. However, her expectations were not always clear and she changed her mind a lot. Be prepared for A LOT of reading.  A "short" reading to professor Shalash is a 150 page novel.
